tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings
tool_schemas.description: Performs the requested sign-in/session, connection, API key, or account operation and returns the created/updated resource, a single resource by id, or a paged list response for list_* actions using limit and cursor (with optional sort_by/sort_order and the corresponding *_filter). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, ids do not match the required dbmcp_* patterns, enums/limits are out of range, or additionalProperties are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks the required account/connection access or API-key scope (admin required for account updates) and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when configured session/key/connection limits are exceeded. Raises NOT_FOUND when the referenced account_id/connection_id/session_id/api_key_id does not exist (or is deleted) and CONFLICT when a requested state transition is not allowed (e.g., signing out an already-revoked/expired session, revoking an already-revoked key, setting a default connection that is not active or not owned by the account, validating a disabled/deleted connection, or deleting/ updating resources not in a mutable state).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return for list operations.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for list operations.

sort_by.description: Field to sort list results by.

account_id.description: Filter connections by owning account id.

is_default.description: Filter connections by whether they are the default connection.

workspace_id.description: Filter connections by Databricks workspace id.

databricks_host.description: Filter connections by Databricks host URL.

connections_filter.description: Filtering options for listing Databricks connections.

email.description: Filter accounts by exact email address.

account_id.description: Filter API keys by owning account id.

connection_id.description: Filter API keys by bound connection id.

scope.description: Filter API keys that include a specific scope.

api_keys_filter.description: Filtering options for listing API keys.

account_id.description: Owning account id for the connection.

name.description: Human-friendly name for the Databricks connection.

set_default.description: Parameters for setting a connection as default.

name.description: Human-friendly name for the API key.

scopes.description: Scopes granted to the API key.

revoke_api_key.description: Parameters for revoking an API key.

display_name.description: New display name for the account.

update_account.description: Fields for updating an account (admin/operator use).

tool_schemas.name: Who Am I
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity and entitlements for the presented credential (session token or API key), including effective scopes and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses requests with missing/invalid/revoked/expired credentials.

session_token.description: Active session token presented by the client; matched against auth_sessions.session_token_hash.

api_key.description: Active API key presented by the client; matched against api_keys.key_hash.

tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings (auth_sessions)
tool_schemas.description: Creates, lists, fetches, expires, or revokes authentication sessions for an account and connection. Enforces that suspended/deleted accounts cannot create sessions and that new sessions may only target active connections. Revocation sets revoked_at=now() and cannot be undone.

session_token.description: Active session token presented by the client; matched against auth_sessions.session_token_hash for authenticated operations.

api_key.description: Active API key presented by the client; matched against api_keys.key_hash for authenticated operations.

account_id.description: Account id that owns the session(s).

connection_id.description: Connection id to bind a new session to (must be active).

client_metadata.description: Arbitrary client info for auditability (e.g., user agent, ip, device name).

expires_in_seconds.description: Requested session lifetime in seconds for create_session.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return for list_sessions.

sort_by.description: Field to sort list_sessions results by.

account_id.description: Filter sessions by owning account id.

connection_id.description: Filter sessions by bound connection id.

sessions_filter.description: Filtering options for listing auth sessions.

tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings (api_keys)
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single API key by id and returns metadata (never the raw key). Refuses access without a valid session/API key credential or when the key is not visible to the calling account.

session_token.description: Active session token presented by the client; matched against auth_sessions.session_token_hash.

api_key.description: Active API key presented by the client; matched against api_keys.key_hash.

api_key_id.description: API key id (dbmcp_key_...) to fetch key metadata.

tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings (rotate_api_key)
tool_schemas.description: Rotates an API key by creating a new key row and revoking the old one in the same operation. Returns the new API key material once and the new key metadata; refuses rotation for suspended/deleted accounts or if the old key is already revoked.

session_token.description: Active session token presented by the client; matched against auth_sessions.session_token_hash.

api_key.description: Active API key presented by the client; matched against api_keys.key_hash.

api_key_id.description: Existing API key id to rotate (will be revoked).

name.description: Optional new display name for the rotated key.

scopes.description: Scopes for the new key; defaults to the scopes of the old key if omitted.

expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp for the new key.

tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings (connections_maintenance)
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes a connection and performs required maintenance on sessions that reference it by either revoking them or clearing connection_id, preserving FK integrity. Refuses if the caller is not authorized or if the connection is already deleted.

session_token.description: Active session token presented by the client; matched against auth_sessions.session_token_hash.

api_key.description: Active API key presented by the client; matched against api_keys.key_hash.

connection_id.description: Connection id to soft-delete and maintain references for.

on_referenced_sessions.description: How to handle existing sessions referencing the connection during deletion.

metadata.name: Databricks MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores authentication state and configuration for connecting an MCP server to Databricks workspaces. The primary workflow is a user (or operator) creating and managing one or more Databricks server/workspace connections via sign-in, maintaining session state and auditability. Repository
